me-hv.label: DC heavy defeats
me-hv.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
me-hv.filters: Lost by 40+ runs or with 30+ balls to spare
me-hv.query: WITH ms AS (SELECT m.match_id, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, replace(m.date, '/', '-') dt, m.venue_id, v.city, m.team1_id t1, m.team2_id t2, m.winner_id w FROM matches m LEFT JOIN venues v ON v.venue_id = m.venue_id), inn AS (SELECT i.match_id, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 1 THEN i.batting_team_id END) bat1, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 1 THEN i.runs END) r1, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 2 THEN i.runs END) r2, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 2 THEN i.total_legal_balls END) b2, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) so FROM innings i GROUP BY i.match_id), dl AS (SELECT d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sixes, SUM(d.total_runs) runs FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY d.match_id) SELECT ms.*, CAST(strftime('%w', ms.dt) AS INTEGER) wd, inn.bat1, inn.r1, inn.r2, inn.b2, inn.so, COALESCE(dl.sixes, 0) sixes, COALESCE(dl.runs, 0) runs FROM ms JOIN inn ON inn.match_id = ms.match_id LEFT JOIN dl ON dl.match_id = ms.match_id ORDER BY ms.dt

me-low.label: DC innings under 120 (min. ten overs faced)
me-low.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
me-low.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, i.runs, i.wickets FROM innings i JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (8,11) AND i.total_legal_balls >= 60 ORDER BY i.runs
